title: Season poster and program listings

location.series: COLLINS / San Francisco Symphony case study
location.extent: Whole published artwork or representative frame of complete local clip

slide_intent: Separate the season identifier from detailed listings because visitors need both orientation and specific choices.
strategic_value: A central expressive season panel can unify many smaller program advertisements.
demonstration: A wall-mounted triptych places a black 2021 season poster between dense groups of performer images and program information.
practical_value: Use a dominant identity panel to anchor a denser schedule display.

content_islands.name: Season anchor
content_islands.spec: Keep the large central black panel and its changing-height numerals.

content_islands.name: Program panels
content_islands.spec: Place the image-led listings to either side within the shared exterior frame.
